WITH all_players AS (
  SELECT 
    m.id as match_id,
    m.home_team_api_id,
    m.away_team_api_id,
    m.home_team_goal,
    m.away_team_goal,
    p.player_api_id
  FROM "Match" m
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    VALUES 
      (m.home_player_1), (m.home_player_2), (m.home_player_3), (m.home_player_4), (m.home_player_5),
      (m.home_player_6), (m.home_player_7), (m.home_player_8), (m.home_player_9), (m.home_player_10), (m.home_player_11)
  ) AS p(player_api_id)
  WHERE p.player_api_id IS NOT NULL
  
  UNION ALL
  
  SELECT 
    m.id as match_id,
    m.home_team_api_id,
    m.away_team_api_id,
    m.home_team_goal,
    m.away_team_goal,
    p.player_api_id
  FROM "Match" m
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    VALUES 
      (m.away_player_1), (m.away_player_2), (m.away_player_3), (m.away_player_4), (m.away_player_5),
      (m.away_player_6), (m.away_player_7), (m.away_player_8), (m.away_player_9), (m.away_player_10), (m.away_player_11)
  ) AS p(player_api_id)
  WHERE p.player_api_id IS NOT NULL
),
player_results AS (
  SELECT 
    player_api_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN home_team_api_id IS NOT NULL AND home_team_goal > away_team_goal THEN 1 
             WHEN away_team_api_id IS NOT NULL AND away_team_goal > home_team_goal THEN 1 
             ELSE 0 END) as total_wins,
    SUM(CASE WHEN home_team_api_id IS NOT NULL AND home_team_goal < away_team_goal THEN 1 
             WHEN away_team_api_id IS NOT NULL AND away_team_goal < home_team_goal THEN 1 
             ELSE 0 END) as total_losses
  FROM all_players
  GROUP BY player_api_id
)
SELECT 
  'highest_wins' as category,
  pl.player_name,
  pr.total_wins as match_count
FROM player_results pr
JOIN Player pl ON pr.player_api_id = pl.player_api_id
WHERE pr.total_wins = (SELECT MAX(total_wins) FROM player_results)

UNION ALL

SELECT 
  'highest_losses' as category,
  pl.player_name,
  pr.total_losses as match_count
FROM player_results pr
JOIN Player pl ON pr.player_api_id = pl.player_api_id
WHERE pr.total_losses = (SELECT MAX(total_losses) FROM player_results)
